text:
Jen (support): FYI VioHealth reporting intermittent 502/504s on hosted inference when they run a long multi-step pipeline (generate -> embed -> rerank). Started ~2026-03-16 14:05 UTC. SDK v1.3.2. Customer says errors correlate with >10k token prompts and heavy concurrent requests. Raising to eng/sre, attaching repro steps & logs below. @Alex @Mike

ingress-bot: ALERT: gateway returned 502 (x12 in 5m) for tenant viohealth-prod, region: us-west1.

Alex (eng): thanks Jen. can you paste a sample request_id and a minimal repro (curl + headers)? curious if this is kv-cache locking or h2 window/circuit-breaker. also what's their per-tenant concurrency?

Jen (support): sample req ids: r-20260316-501, r-20260316-508, r-20260316-521. minimal repro (redacted):
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \ 
  -H "X-Tenant: viohealth-prod" \ 
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-2","input":"<~12k tokens prompt>","pipeline":["generate","embed","rerank"]}'
```
logs snippet (trimmed):
```
2026-03-16T14:05:12Z r-20260316-501 upstream error: 502 gateway_reset upstream="eng-runtime-usw1"
2026-03-16T14:05:12Z r-20260316-501 proxy: connection id=564 reset by peer during write
2026-03-16T14:05:13Z r-20260316-508 upstream error: 504 read_timeout tenant=viohealth-prod
```
Customer also reports client SDK retries causing duplicate billing records when the gateway returns 5xx quickly.

Mike (sre): initial thoughts: looks like an ingress-level reset when a long streaming write blocks and our proxy circuit-breaker trips. two likely levers: increase keepalive + stream window for the route OR add short-term per-tenant concurrency cap to avoid head-of-line blocking. also confirm if their requests are using HTTP/2 multiplexing heavy (that can hit window exhaustion).

Alex (eng): agree. small checklist to repro locally:
1) set SDK v1.3.2, enable streaming.
2) send 4 concurrent long prompts (~10k tokens) against a canary endpoint with tenant header.
3) watch proxy logs for `connection reset by peer` and our circuit-breaker counters.
4) capture envoy metrics: `downstream_rq_pending_overflow` + `circuit_breaker.<tenant>.cx_overflow`.

Jen (support): I reproduced step 1-3 in staging with SDK v1.3.2 — saw the same reset pattern after ~45s on the longest request. attaching staging req id: r-staging-20260316-77.

Kira (pm): for customer comms we should be explicit and give mitigation steps. proposed message: "We're investigating intermittent 5xx for long pipelines on hosted inference. Temporary mitigation: reduce concurrent long requests and enable client chunking (SDK param chunk_size=2048) or set stream_timeout=60s. We're working on a fix and will update in 4 hours." ok?

Jen (support): customer ok with that comms. they asked for a config snippet to chunk calls from their side — pasted below for their SDK: 
```
client = RedwoodClient(token)
resp = client.generate(prompt, stream=True, chunk_size=2048, stream_timeout=60)
```

Alex (eng): dev note: I suspect a bug in ingress h2 window calculation when total sequence length > ~10k. will run a unit repro and check kernel's write batching. filing internal ticket RT-4219 and assigning to eng-runtime.

Mike (sre): immediate mitigation we can flip from our side: temporarily bump route keepalive from 30s -> 90s for viohealth-prod + enable per-tenant soft-concurrency limit = 6. I'll open infra change request and attach to RT-4219.

Jen (support): looping billing: they confirmed duplicate billing events when SDK retries after 5xx. I've notified billing team and asked for retroactive credit if count>1.

Alex (eng): thanks. my next steps: reproduce in-cpu, run trace on KV cache and h2 windows, post findings here.

Mike (sre): I'll apply the temporary ingress changes and monitor. will update thread when done (~30-60m).

Jen (support): customer notified with mitigation + comms. they accepted temporary workaround. I'll post status updates here and keep them in the loop.

Alex (eng): confirmed reproduced locally, creating minimal repro script and attaching to RT-4219.

Mike (sre): ingress change applied (keepalive 90s, soft cap 6) — monitoring now. early signal: 5xx rate for viohealth-prod dropped to 0.8% from ~6% over last 10m.

Jen (support): thanks all. I'll update customer with the improvement and mark ticket support-1187 as in-progress. will follow up after eng fix. :thumbsup:
